narrative: Bishopsgate at dusk, looking south toward the close. Shop shutters going up. One torch at a door, not a bonfire. The kennel catching a little light. No moon. No one hailed. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Passed the doors and went on toward the close.

entities.name: Bishopsgate
entities.context: In photo: Dusk on the way home
